metadata.name: nanosteg.host
metadata.description: Imports provider for the NanoSteg WAT module: returns { imports:{}, onInstantiate } and captures the module's live instance (memory + exports) into a per-State registry when it instantiates. Named on the WAT cel's metadata.imports so the wat compiler's host-instance hook hands it the instance.

metadata.name: nanosteg.embed
metadata.description: (rgba, w, h, payload, password, core) → RGBA8 buffer with payload hidden in the R/G/B LSBs. Writes the pixel/password/payload bytes into the captured WAT instance's memory at fixed protocol offsets, calls hash_password then embed, and reads the modified RGBA back. Pure byte-plumbing — the steg algorithm is the WAT source on the sheet. Returns a capacity CelError when the payload does not fit.

metadata.name: nanosteg.decode
metadata.description: (rgba, w, h, password, core) → recovered UTF-8 text from the image alone (blind — no cover). Writes the pixels + password into the captured WAT instance's memory, calls hash_password then decode, and reads the payload back; a magic miss (wrong password) returns a readable warning string instead of throwing.
